## Frame reference

### `document` channel

#### `open` — client → server

FixtureOpenFrame asks the fixture wire to open something.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `string` | yes |  |
| `opId` | `string` | no | echoed on the reply |
| `name` | `string` | yes | what to open |

#### `ping` — client → server

FixturePingFrame is a liveness probe on the fixture wire.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `string` | yes |  |

#### `opened` — server → client

FixtureOpenedFrame answers a fixture open.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `string` | yes |  |
| `body` | `string` | yes |  |
| `marks` | `map[string]string` | no | an open bag of annotations |
| `opId` | `string` | yes |  |

### `workspace` channel

#### `notice` — server → client

FixtureNotice is an uncorrelated broadcast on the fixture wire.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `string` | yes |  |
| `topic` | `gen.FixtureTopic` | yes |  |
| `details` | `[]string` | no | lines the client may show |
| `silent` | `*bool` | no | absent leaves the client's own preference alone |

## Typed HTTP endpoints

An endpoint appears here when its contract is typed data in either direction.
Everything else the app serves is hypermedia or bytes, and appears in the route
inventory below instead.

| Operation | Response | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `POST /api/thing` | fragment | FixtureCreateRequest makes a fixture thing. |
| `PATCH /api/thing/{id}` | json | FixturePatchRequest changes a fixture thing's name. |

### `POST /api/thing`

**Request** — `gen.FixtureCreateRequest`

Accepts `application/json` or `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`, under the same field names.

FixtureCreateRequest makes a fixture thing.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` | yes | what to call it |

**Response** — fragment.

### `PATCH /api/thing/{id}`

Path parameters: `id`

**Request** — `gen.FixturePatchRequest`

FixturePatchRequest changes a fixture thing's name.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `owner` | `string` | yes | who is asking; a query parameter, not a body field |
| `name` | `string` | yes | the new name |

**Response** — `gen.FixturePatchResponse`

FixturePatchResponse reports the version the patch produced.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `version` | `int` | yes |  |

Types a frame or an endpoint carries inside its envelope. Each is described on

FixtureContent is the body a fixture open answers with.

### `gen.FixtureTopic`

FixtureTopic is the subject a fixture notice names.

## Command words

Every registered verb. They ride the workspace wire's `command` frame as DATA —
a new command is not a new frame type — and are listed because a client has to
spell both the verb and the family it is invoked within: the dispatcher rejects
a verb sent under a family that is not its own.

| Family | Command | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `fixture` | `/do-a-thing` | Do the fixture thing |
| `fixture` | `/undo-a-thing` | Undo the fixture thing |
| `other` | `/elsewhere` | A verb in a second family |

## Route inventory

Every route the app mounts, walked off the assembled router. `/ui/*` is safe,
idempotent views and bytes; `/api/*` is operations and protocols. A route whose
contract is typed data is described above; the rest serve hypermedia, bytes,
or another protocol's own transport.

| Method | Path | Contract |
|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/api/ws/document/{uuid}` | WebSocket channel |
| `GET` | `/api/ws/workspace` | WebSocket channel |
| `GET` | `/ui/views/thing` | — |
| `PATCH` | `/api/thing/{id}` | typed (json) |
| `POST` | `/api/thing` | typed (fragment) |
